Subject: Quick recap + next step: 30m intro demo (two/three time options)

Hi Samir / Anna —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap of what we heard from your side:
- Primary objective: reduce retraining cycle time and inference cost for internal models used in threat detection.
- Key constraints: must integrate with existing S3 storage, and inference must run in-host (private deployment) for logs retention reasons.
- Stakeholders to include: Platform lead (Samir), SecOps (Anna), and one AI infra engineer to validate latency/kv-cache behavior.

Next step: propose a 30-minute product intro/demo where we walk through:
1) How Redwood routes and isolates inference workloads (private deployment overview)
2) Live walkthrough of KV cache + latency profiles on comparable models
3) Integration checklist and next steps (POC timeline)

Can you confirm which of these stakeholders should be on the demo and share 2–3 windows that work? I’ve attached a short recap and a proposed 30m agenda.

If helpful, Dylan (cc’d) can join the demo to cover engineering and integration questions.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
